findings.description: Removing the already_bracketed check means an optional parameter whose metavar is already bracketed (e.g. metavar="[FOO]") is now wrapped again, producing "[[FOO]]" in the usage line.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an option with required=False and a user-supplied metavar such as "[FOO]". Before this change the code skipped the extra brackets; now line 3576 always wraps, so the usage string becomes "[[FOO]]". Impact: help and usage output shows doubled brackets for such CLIs, a visible regression in generated help text.
